governance_service_sole_policy_owner.details: GovernanceService is the single authoritative owner for CW01/CW03/CW04 availability, surface state, projection, and redaction policies. Default dataset surface status fails closed to "unavailable" when source is missing or unknown. dataset_source defaults to "missing" when callback is absent or returns None. Explicit collection surface state helpers (committee_collection_surface_state and memo_collection_surface_state) enforce provenance precedence, ensuring raw unavailable/missing/unknown provenance fails closed to "unavailable" regardless of injected callback status while preserving valid stale/degraded semantics. Callback exceptions in _safe_dataset_surface_status fail closed to "unavailable". Exception fallback is strictly limited to intended policy/provenance callbacks (dataset_source, dataset_surface_status, redact_evidence_refs, capabilities_for_identity); store read operations (_call) never swallow read errors into empty results, preventing read failures from being mislabeled healthy-empty.

unavailable_dominates_and_fail_closed_in.details: Explicit collection surface state helpers enforce that an unavailable underlying dataset dominates and renders the collection "unavailable". In list_consult_memos, records are projected to the published safe summary contract (RedTeamMemoSummary), preventing exposure of summary, recommendations list, or evidence_refs in listings, and individual unavailable memo records suppress recommendation_count to 0. An unavailable memo or committee collection suppresses item rows (empty list and total 0). consult_memo_projection strictly disables canInitiateGovernanceReview (False) whenever record or collection surface state is degraded or unavailable. Redaction failures fail closed to "redaction_policy_unavailable".

router_divergent_defaults_removed.details: Removed router-level pass-through redaction _default_redact_evidence_refs and optimistic _default_dataset_surface_status; router now delegates both to GovernanceService. Missing surface in _default_read_surface_meta defaults to source="missing". Router list_committees and list_consult_memos delegate surface state resolution, pagination, and projection directly to GovernanceService.

contract_test_matrix_and_red_cases.details: Extended prerequisite test suite to 34 tests (21 predecessor + 13 new), covering: 3 fixed red cases ((1) memo degraded x dataset unavailable suppresses summary & forces CTA False; (2) omitted provenance is not ok/fresh & CTA False; (3) router omitted redactor + capabilities=[] reveals no strategy evidence); the full 16-combination (4 record x 4 dataset states) availability and CTA truth table for both CW03 committees and CW04 memos across BOTH list and detail for service and router; production callback precedence verification (test_production_callback_cannot_override_unavailable_source); safe list summary contract and omitted-redactor verification (test_list_cannot_bypass_unavailable_content_and_omitted_redactor); full callback error fail-closed handling (surface status, unknown provenance, redactor, capabilities); store read failures failing closed rather than returning healthy-empty items; healthy genuine-empty positives returning state=ok; positive authorized real-redactor disclosure; and production composition wiring live request execution.
